title: Helpers--Extraction Workers
description: Help extraction craft workers, such as earth drillers, blasters and explosives workers, derrick operators, and mining machine operators, by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include supplying equipment or cleaning work area.

tasks.text: Observe and monitor equipment operation during the extraction process to detect any problems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Extraction operations oversight is physical, hazardous, human-led

tasks.text: Drive moving equipment to transport materials and parts to excavation sites.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Truck driving needs real-world navigation and control

dwas.name: Drive trucks or truck-mounted equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Unload materials, devices, and machine parts, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical loading in construction or extraction

dwas.name: Load or unload materials used in construction or extraction.

tasks.text: Set up and adjust equipment used to excavate geological materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mining equipment operated in unstructured environment

tasks.text: Organize materials to prepare for use.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Construction material selection needs code and site judgment

tasks.text: Repair and maintain automotive and drilling equipment, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on drilling equipment maintenance

tasks.text: Clean up work areas and remove debris after extraction activities are complete.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Work site cleaning is physical labor

tasks.text: Clean and prepare sites for excavation or boring.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Work site cleaning is physical labor

dwas.name: Prepare excavation or extraction sites for commissioning or decommissioning.

tasks.text: Load materials into well holes or into equipment, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of construction equipment

tasks.text: Provide assistance to extraction craft workers, such as earth drillers and derrick operators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assisting of skilled trades on site

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.

tasks.text: Collect and examine geological matter, using hand tools and testing devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical extraction of geological samples

tasks.text: Signal workers to start geological material extraction or boring.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Directing equipment operators via physical signals

dwas.name: Signal equipment operators to indicate proper equipment positioning.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Dismantle extracting and boring equipment used for excavation, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on drilling equipment maintenance
physical manipulation — Manual digging with tools in ground
